title: Pareto principle
src: Vilfredo Pareto, popularized by Joseph Juran
idea: Roughly 80% of results come from 20% of causes. A few inputs do most of the work.
apply: List everything on your plate, circle the two items that move the outcome, and do those first.
remind: Find the two things that matter. Do those first.
who: Maya, a freelance designer with five clients.

scenes.nar: Maya is a freelance designer with five clients. She gives each one the same amount of time.
But two clients bring in eighty percent of her income. The other three bring in twenty.

items.x: Thu: batch edits for C, D and E

scenes.nar: So she gives those two her best hours first, and batches the other three into one afternoon.
